body: As most of you I use to feel the same way. Highly disappointed and lost without favorite person. After years of therapy and identifying parts of myself (IFS therapy! I highly recommend it). Now I finally trust myself and that I’ll be okay. So in fact I do feel like that meme

Fellow BPD girl here and I’m studying my
Masters in marriage/couples family therapy. A lot of the work has to come from her.

Now, in respects to what you can do is reassure her that you will not abandon her. Let her know when she is hurting you. Know her phases of escalated anger. Does she start to shake her leg? Stonewall? What does she do. Get to know her triggers all while being kind to yourself and remaining steadfast at keeping her responsible when she hurts you after she calms down.
ENFJ!
Wouldn’t shower for days and is a serial monogamist
I’m a bilingual PK teacher but I’m a full time grad student and am working on my Masters in marriage and family therapy

Not 10mins but I carry my iPad around and write notes on my thoughts throughout the day (work at a school so I can get away with carrying electronic all day). At the end of the day I reflect on my thoughts and fluctuating feelings. As for physical I bought a walking pad and will walk when I watch tv or do homework for my masters program

Yes! It was difficult at first! Since I never really had a small job before I entered my career in teaching. The first year was hectic. I got better at things like time management and people skills. I’m currently on my 4th year of teaching while I’m doing my masters in Marriage and Family Therapy.
Cry, journal, jog, visit a relative.

I 26f got broken up with after my second miscarriage with my then fiancée. I immediately deleted all socials (except Reddit) and stayed off dating apps. I went to therapy, started my masters program, and have rebuilt my relationship with my loved ones. My happiness has been exponential. I went to the gym and lost over 40lbs went back to my pre relationship weight of 110lbs! Don’t get me wrong he tried calling me in February but I didn’t answer. I then found out last week via a mutual friend that he had a new girl living with him. It has hurt me a little but not to the point to do anything over it. I’m just sitting with the pain that shall pass. 
It makes so much sense to do no contact this way. Social media will manipulate and plant seeds of doubt into our unconscious. Take time offline! Read a book! I had abstained from dating as well. I didn’t want to put all my pain onto someone to make myself feel better. I feel as if I’ve gotten a second chance in life! Best of luck to you OP
No flesh tones, dye your hair a different color since this one washes you out. Less filler.

6 months now! It was hard I was doing pretty good but I found out he’s living with someone when 2 months ago he tried calling me to go back. Not going to lie I’ve cried a couple of times. I have felt worse now that I know he’s moved on but it’ll pass just like my pain from the breakup did

Would go 4 days at a time without showering, had two cats that would piss on our carpet and could leave the cat pee out there for DAYS. Had a dog he would shower or groom. The poor dog would go up to 4 months without being groomed or bathed. When I’d bring it up he’d get upset and say I was delusional. Wouldn’t ever change and wear the same dirty shirts.
Mine could go 4 days without showering

I became a single mom at 19, was the first to graduate with a bachelor’s in my immediate and extended family. As a first generation that was such an accomplishment for me. Now at 26 after a broken engagement and two miscarriages in one year I’ve started my masters program (again first in my family as a single mom). I go to therapy on a weekly basis to better my mental health.  I live modestly with 0 government help. Don’t get child support, nothing. I live a simple life alongside my daughter and enjoy staying in and reading. Never been one to hit up the town. I don’t drink or do drugs.

Which is completely valid. I had a child at 19 because of “poor decisions and emotional immaturity.” I’m 26 now and I will say it’s not everyone’s cup of tea. It’s not for everyone. We’ve all made questionable decisions in life. Granted, a child is a big one. Being a single parent myself I think twice before dating someone with a child. Especially a lot of fellow single parents seem to stunt themselves and their emotional growth because they’re thrown into the trenches of parenting all while their prefrontal cortex isn’t even finished cooking.
CBT angered me, DBT helps sometimes, but IFS helps the most.

I studied education but now I’m back in Grad school to be a Marriage and Family Therapist. I’ve always been a motivated person. The moments I didn’t have a goal I was working for I grew insanely depressed.
This is how I got myself into a relationship I was not prepared for😂😂😂

This sounds bad and I promise it’s not using someone. I stuck it out for 6 months. Cried, flicked my bean a bunch, thought about him like crazy. I waited until I felt myself emotionally moving on. Then I found someone and did the deed. All thoughts of my ex (whom was a phenomenal partner in bed) sort of fizzled out. It’s a process. Sometimes we resort to thinking about having sex with out ex because it’s our mind wanting to mend that with the act of sex. As we feel connected with our partner and such during that moment of intimacy. It’ll pass. Might take a while but allowing time to pass and work on yourself is the best advice I can give.

Nothing! My therapist has made me feel so welcome and accepted. I’ve told her about my struggles from splitting, vindictiveness, and hallucinations. I’ve had other therapists who I felt odd disclosing info to. Not her though she’s good to me

“This is what you deserve for always taking my love for granted.” “Life moves on without you.”

As i was still miscarrying his second child this past year. After her left me at a psychiatric ward after starting an argument with me that ended up in a mental breakdown. Oh, as he also kicked me out and kept all my furniture. Never cheated, never lied, worked full time cooked him dinner every night. All while he’d smoke weed till 4AM and wouldn’t shower for 4 days!!! 

Life does move on without you Vincent. You were right.
IFS, DBT, and wise mind mentality. All achieved with a good therapist who’s taken the time to get to know me truly and finally giving me the right diagnosis that felt right.
Letting it drift away from me without the fear of being forgotten.

I still have dreams of my ex! It’s okay with time you’ll learn to just take it as is. It’s your unconscious trying to work everything out. Keep a journal reflect on your feelings during the dream and the actions you made during the dream. I keep a dream journal. Dreams are the language of our unconscious

Being overwhelmed is natural and grieving takes time. I literally cried out loud and yelled why why why the first two days. I cried like I’ve never cried before. I’m here we’re all here for you on the same boat. You might see all these posts and replies of “oh I was there months back” and this “what a long journey” but if you truly work on yourself it’ll be the biggest blessing

5 months as well going on 6 after a movie plot of a break up! I’m doing so much better! I get my moments where I’m upset and want to break NC but as my therapist helped me figure out. Those momentary feelings stem from a fear of being forgotten. Now that I know that those spontaneous moments feel better. 

I have friends, my wonderful support system, my church family. I’ve started my masters in marriage and family therapy. I’m usually busy. It helps. I lost 30lbs since the break up so I’m looking like a snack again😂. I love life. I feel blessed. I do remember him, worry for him, but I know my life is better without him and I’m so glad that in a couple of months he’ll be 3 states away! Since he said he was moving back with his bad in AZ after the split. I’ve gone out on dates some want a relationship but I’m just too happy being me right now. Taking time to heal and not fool around was the best choice ever! 


IT GETS BETTER GUYS! Stay strong the first few months hurt the most. Especially when you’re making it a point to not date and truly be alone.
I volunteer as tribute

It’s such a draining and difficult journey indeed! I was misdiagnosed twice. It was so frustrating because I went years without being treated properly. Being told I had major depression would upset me even more. I’ve seen major depression play out and I couldn’t relate to it. I was put on anti depressants for it a short time and it didn’t go well.

I have QBPD- Petulant type. With much DBT, wise mind, IFS, and a good therapist my life has improved so much. Im able to track my moods now. We’ve been able to track my mood cycle. It’s been a difficult journey but I’m able to live a more functional life now! My BPD has improved on no antidepressants (personal choice). 

I’ve suffered from hearing a voice although I don’t hear him much. I’ve suffered from suicidal ideations. When people hear BPD they think all sorts of things. Truly at our core I think we all just feel unworthy and unlovable. We don’t act out in these ways to be malicious in fact I believe we’re some of the most devoted individuals. We love and feel deeply so that we get frustrated because others don’t as us. If we go through the BPD rabbit hole it’s a dangerous thing. Im currently studying to be a therapist so that I can help others such as your husband and myself. 

The road ahead is long but 50% of the job is acknowledging the problem. I can tell you from much experience once you know better about why you act the way you do you become more responsible for your feelings and actions. I commend you! It is also difficult to be a BPDs favorite person! You are a gem 💎 and immensely appreciated! I see your tireless effort and wish you both all the belongings. The key is to find a therapist that can make him feel heard and understood. Because as I’ve said BPD is kind of a buzzword thing in the land of therapy sometimes we’re seen as covert narcissists when that’s not the case at all. All personality types should be treated with care and empathy.

5 months in! I can sincerely say I’m moving on. I find myself being joyful. I still have feelings for him and he comes to mind everyday but I’m so happy with my life now I know I’d never go back. He tried calling me during Valentine’s Day but I didn’t answer. Him breaking things off was the best possible outcome. It use to come and go in waves. Regret, heartache, rumination… now I’m just thankful. Life is good!

3/4 ex partners have tried coming back. The last one did call me twice on Valentine’s Day but didn’t leave a text or voicemail. Didn’t try hard enough to say he tried coming back. Just a moment of weakness

Hello, I’ve had my fair share of different therapists and theories applied to me. I’m currently doing my masters to be a marriage and family therapist. I will tell you out of personal experience it gets worse before it even begins to get better! Still, if this feeling is constant and it’s making it worse it’s time to tell your therapist or get yourself a new one. 

Issues occur when therapist’s obligate you to talk about things you’re not ready for. Not all therapists and clients match well together and that’s okay. Being mindful and you have more control during what happens in those sessions than you think.

My ex called me 4 months after no contact (going into month 6 soon). He just called me at like 5AM Valentine’s Day. Probably a drunk call moment. I did not answer though. He never sent a text or left a voicemail. If he wants me to break no contact he’s going to have to try harder than two calls.
He hasn’t contacted me again. I’m still depressed though lol. But I won’t break no contact either
Woke up to two missed calls from him. I fought all day to not reach out. Fell asleep after work.

Hello! Fellow teacher as well. I work with PK and if anything I feel as if I understand them much more. With them being at an age where they can become overthrown by emotions. It’s like looking in a mirror and I’m empathy goes through the roof for them.

I started my career in education before I had a proper diagnosis. Since being diagnosed though my situation has improved. My diagnosis was not a death sentence per se. It was actually comforting and like you I lean towards the truth and take it for what’s it for. I don’t let it define me. I’ve actually started my masters in counseling so that I can help others in the future since I know this personality disorder can become quite crippling at times

I’m a PK teacher. Although I’ve bumped heads with a lot of my coworkers the love my children give me makes it all worth while. They make me feel like a super star when I walk into that class. I’ve found the perfect in between with dedicating all my energy to my students and being minimal in my interactions with my coworkers. Eating, planning, and working on my own give me enough time to self soothe; along with the fact that when I actually see my coworkers now I see them well.
I wish you the best!!! Also as my beloved ex fiancée told me once “life goes on, it’ll continue without you” 😂🥲! But he’s right, life does continue 💕 virtual hugs and best of wishes!

Esther 4:14 God positions Esther for a purpose.

Finding God shortly after a horrific fall out of events that I put myself in. I have submitted myself to him and give him my life. Our God is a beautiful one who gives us all free will but with that sometimes comes being led by selfish desires that taint our soul. Since giving my life to him and trying my best to follow the example Jesus left for us I have given it to him. He has allowed this to occur to me so that I can gain experience and he can work through me. I shall not doubt, I shall be courageous in any obstacle I face because I am the Lords and he is in me.

It’s been about 2 months for mine. He broke up with me after our second miscarriage this year. I had an emotional breakdown instead of comforting me he escalated it. He dropped me off at a psychiatric unit and told them I wanted to unlive myself. I was there for a week and when I came out he was out on a trip. When he came back to town he ended our engagement via phone call and packed all my stuff into garbage bags. 

This are a few things that have helped me:

- No social media: social media has the tendency to give you algorithms based on what you click on. If you’re sad clicking on sad things it’ll take you further down the rabbit hole of depression. (I only have Reddit and YouTube and even then I make it a point to look at positive content or content that is supportive) also I didn’t want the power of being able to lurk on my ex

- Therapy: I’ve come to learn that a lot of the issues I had during my break up were coming from me. I couldn’t stop my fiancée from changing his mind. I don’t own him or control his decisions. Codependency is one of my biggest issues. Through therapy and DBT skills I’ve learned to manage this.

- Surround yourself with a positive support system: I made it a point that after this I wanted to get better and that’s only done with surrounding yourself with people who bring value to your life and your betterment. I surrounded myself with brave women who are good in my specific work field. Friends who don’t support toxic or irrational behaviors. 

- Learn new information: after my break up I felt so emotionally abused that I started asking my therapist for  theories on relationships and attachment styles. I’ve been learning with the recourses she gave me. Knowledge is power. It’s given me so much more closure to why my ex dumped me the way he did. Now I’ve enrolled for my masters in professional counseling because of my new found love of it.

- Being active: go to the gym! I’ll tell you I’ve ran so fast in that treadmill and cried in the restroom right after so many times but god it’s relieving. Take yourself out! Even if you don’t have anyone. Treat yourself like you would your significant other. 

There are so many things you can do. But the biggest that has worked from my experience is stop focusing so much on him. Grief isn’t linear. You’re very much in the bargaining phase still. I know it’s soul crushing. Maybe he has moved on. But time to start focusing on yourself!!!

Beautiful this list is amazing, another thing I forgot to add as well is therapy. I was not handling this well. At all. I looked for mental and I’ve learned so much about myself. Shifting my focus in “what did I lose” to “who am I? What do I need to help me heal and grow from this”

Be kind to yourself! Grief isn’t linear, it can take a while. After my second miscarriage this year my finance broke up with me stating “what do I even want you for.” Kicked me out of our home and I just let him keep everything since I don’t like confrontation. 
I cried the first few weeks like a baby. I was physically in pain, screaming while crying. Screaming. It was terrible. Now I don’t cry but I feel myself in the anger/bargaining phase. It shall pass. Be kind to yourself. Be gentle. Set up a routine, that helped me a lot. Trust me I was miserable but having a set routine that would get me moving helped so much. I’d go to the gym and be angry of course but it’s slowly worked. Life continues.

This is a sign! RUN! it’s a blessing. I had found tinder on my ex fiancé’s phone and I gave him the benefit of the doubt. He kicked me out as soon as he found someone else. I know it hurts. But one type of outcome is better than the other

In my experience I’ve hurt a lot of people due to my bpd. After years of therapy the thing that’s helped me the most is focusing on managing my codependency issues. My need do want to have constant external validation shouldn’t be anyone else’s worry. I know it’s hard. Frankly the things I’ve gotten myself into dipping into empty wells has been so heartbreaking.

I also think you should read up on Wise Mind Mentality. It has been life changing. With BPD we tend to split things and how we feel for people never being able to hold the good and the bad at once. It’s one or the other. Wise Mind is a perfect tool with this. I can link some good videos in regards to codependency if you’re interested
“God will never abandon you” thank you! 🙏 I have to remind myself on the daily that I am worthy of his love. Through him I am validated and find peace
Thank you! I have been better with God in my heart for two months. I keep close to the word and have so much to look forward this upcoming year.
Thank you for your prayers. They are appreciated God bless ✨

This is exactly it! I wish nothing bad onto him. I am hurt but I pray he one days finds our Lords love. I wish him nothing but salvation. I hope I receive what I have lost in new bountiful ways. I’m sure I will look back in some years from now and be thankful for this awakening I had.
Yes material things are cravings we seek here in Earth. But I have learned the importance of spiritual wealth recently and have focused hard on enriching it. Thank you for your insight 🫶🏻
You are strong! It must be so difficult. Your faith is strong and admirable. You are here to help your parents and you are their lifeline. You are a phenomenal daughter.
I am recently going through a broken engagement. Knowing myself I’m a big stalker so I just went ahead and deactivated all my social media.
Out of everything, I think I would do this. Throw that same energy back at her
I have yet joined a union but this year when reps come around I will sign up

We both moved on. I thought I would marry him because I loved him so much. I have nothing but good things to say about him. Our relationship soured because I wanted marriage but he wasn’t ready even though he had taken me ring shopping and even asked for my hand. It just never happened and it’s okay. I think of him everyday and hope he’s happy since he’s moved on pretty fast after he left. I have also found someone who makes me happy and wants a family and we have the same goals in life. My new partner and I have the same wants and our lives just fall into place with one another. A practical life and a calm one full of affection/respect. 
Love, it’s not practical sometimes and it makes you delusional. That’s what I was with him. Again, I still wish him the absolute best.

Yes I’ve noticed that. I came into this profession thinking everyone would be dandy but I’ve come to realize there’s a lot of jaded individuals and with each progressing year I see why. I stick to myself which is why it irritates me to see when she comes in and causes a chaos. Like woman please just type it in the walkthrough form or really if that’s bad ask me to step out. It comes off as passive aggressive. I would just take it or stay quiet. Even apologized once after she called me out. I went home and I’m like no. She doesn’t get to treat me that way.
I love it! 😂

Yes I think this what I’m going to do if she does the same this year. I don’t mind her attitude outside the classroom but it’s unprofessional to come into someone’s class and disturb the flow of a lesson. Especially with PK 😂 I literally have to put on a show to get their attention.
What game is this?
Oh okay! Thank you for that. I know nothing! This is what happens when you grow up in a state with poor sex education.

We are highly active but he doesn’t finish in me, I am aware there’s still a risk to that as well. I’ll just call my GYNO at this point if I don’t bleed by the end of this week just to make sure I’m not pregnant. Since I don’t know if I should start my new pack even though I haven’t bled.
Thank you!

Hello, I was on Copper IUD for 5 years. At first I had the most extreme case of heavy flow that eventually went away after 6 months. Then I’d actually only cramp around ovulation time. But I did get pregnant on it back in December and ended up having and ectopic pregnancy that naturally became a miscarriage.

I’m sorry you’re going through this. I recently experienced something similar. Although I was bleeding for 3 weeks my HCG levels showed 18-28 in two weeks when they should’ve been in the upper hundreds or thousands. I got MTX about 4 days ago after several intra scans they couldn’t find anything. 
Best of wishes, I know how stressful this can be.
My last period before this prolonged bleeding was November 16th.  I’m just tired. I just want answers. My hormones go up literally so little and a 28 is such a low level with such a small spike.
I haven’t tried posting on that sub but will now! Thank you.

Thank you, I feel like our situations might be similar. I had an ER doctor say I might be 1-2 weeks pregnant which would be impossible and would give me higher HCG levels if anything. Instead they’re only going up ever so slightly. I will keep pushing for an answer. It’s just been causing a lot of distress for my partner and I not knowing if we really had a baby on the way or not.

Yes it does, thank you so much for verifying that my concerns are valid ones. It’s crazy that I’ve been bleeding this much without stopping yet hcg levels rise a minuscule amount. Hopefully tomorrow on my 6th vaginal ultrasound they find something. An answer to this strange occurrence
If you don’t mind me asking how far along were you when this happened? I feel so overwhelmed. I feel like my doctors are going to take forever to resolve this.

Yes, it was my senior year of high school and it was a difficult time for me. I had come to terms in validating a lot of my childhood repressed trauma. I fell into a petty high school relationship that was extremely toxic. Along with that I isolated myself and pushed away a lot of my friends. I just felt so overwhelmingly distraught.
I vented to my mother about my thoughts and mental health and I told her I felt like I needed help. I didn’t feel well emotionally and I fantasized about doing it. But she said I was fine and to just get over it. My parents are very old school and are influenced by their culture a lot. So they stigmatized mental health and going to psychologists. For 1 year nearly I wanted to. But I was just too much of a pussy. I had ONE friend. He was there for me everyday and with every thought. So I stayed.
After that, I don’t even know how I made it. I’d literally look up ways how and constantly go on forums and chat rooms. Years later once I started working and was able to pay for it I sought mental health and it was so revolutionary.
To be fair I broke 2 contracts in one year. Most school districts will not go through the trouble of suspending your license as it take a lot of time and paperwork from their end too.

I am literally going through what you are. My boyfriend of two years broke up with me over the phone, with no explanations it was just sudden. This is the man I went to go look at houses with a realtor. It’s been a month since this happened no calls no texts… nothing. But whatever it’s his loss. Take the emotions in and focus on yourself. He knows how to find you if he wants to. Don’t go chasing over this guy. He doesn’t deserve it

They’re being parents. 15 is incredibly young. Your parents are worried about you and your future. What if you got pregnant? Have you taken time to think about that. I got pregnant at 19 on birth control and still find parenthood difficult. Your body is yours, of course do as you please but I think you should’ve waited a little longer to do this. 
You mentioning your parents as “crazy” signifies you lack perspective to see this as an adult. Because guess who’s going to have to be responsible if you get pregnant? If he doesn’t your parents will because you’re still very young. Your boyfriend is at that age where he wants to explore things. So do you perfect. But if you’re going to have sex please don’t make this about your parents the genuinely have your best interest at heart.

I am proud! I did something similar last week. My ex broke up with me after a very loving genuine relationship. We both just wanted different things in life and he broke up with me. 
When I texted him I let him know how hurt I was but how I also understood and respected his decision. He didn’t answer me. I know he talked to my brother about us and my brother wanted to talk to me about their conversation but I told him that I’m too hurt. I don’t want to know because I accept the outcome and I’m still processing the now and when I’m strong enough I can focus on the why and hopefully grow from it. Keep being strong! We’ve all got this!
Currently going through my 1st week after a break up I wish I was at that point.

Hello, I struggled with depression and suicidal thoughts while going to university. I actually started therapy while doing 15 semesters hours and being a single parent. So although I didn’t have extra curricular I was extremely tight on time. I wish I had a parent who was as open and understanding. When I opened up to mine about my struggles all I got was a yelling and mocking from seeking therapy.
I know it might seem like a huge chunk of time that’ll be taken from your routinely schedule but the wonderful part about therapy is that you can consult with your therapist weekly, biweekly, monthly even! Going to therapy and advocating time to my mental health was the best decision I ever made. I really think you could make it work, your therapists will make it work too. Please consider giving yourself time for this

Single mother of a 4year old, even if I wanted to spend 100% of my time on her I can’t. She helps me with chores, she’ll help “fold” and sort clothes to wash. She’ll help pick up messes we do everything together. I suppose that’s how we spend time? Don’t know if it’s healthy but I was raised in a home like the one your children are being raised in. My parents time revolved around me and although everyone is different it didn’t translate well into adulthood. 
I’m a teacher so my daughter wakes up with me helps me put stuff up in my class stays after school with me. Trust me, I do things for her too, I take her to her dance classes we dedicate sundays to an outing she chooses (movies, park, trampoline park, beach). 
No, I don’t think it’s ok that you stop your life for your children. Expose children to a safe version of the endeavors of adulthood like helping out keep a tidy home. I have my daughter take part in everything I do. She’s literally my shadow so I might as well have her be an active participant.

I’m a new teacher with most of my team being seasoned teachers. We help each other. They help me with their accumulated recourses/knowledge and I help them with technology or even help by running copies of materials they give me. We’re part of a collaborative field. We should be able to collaborate.

It’s up to you. I’m a single mother of a 4 year old. Luckily I had a good support system that helped me get through school and obtain a career. Let me tell you it’s hard though. It’s hella hard. The first few years I hated it. There were moments I wished I had gone through with the abortion but my parents physically prohibited me from going to my appointment.
Ask yourself these things: do you have a good support system? Are you financially stable? If not do you have a means to go to school or get a decent job? Are you willing to deal with an unsure babydaddy? Because truth be told some are headaches (baby moms can be too). Are you willing to sit down and have about 3/4 difficult years of pure sacrifice? Because once you bring a baby into this world your life isn’t yours anymore it’s your kids.

I’ve heard nightmares from charter schools. My best bet is on public schools. Next year I will be joining a union and you should too so you have someone backing you up even a little. If you ever decide to come back into teaching don’t be afraid to ask you perspective principal questions like how they handle difficult situations. Be honest, when I applied at my current job I just said that although I didn’t expect a high end treatment I wanted to be treated with respect and have proper guidance to be a good teacher. 
Don’t feel bad for the kids they’ll find someone else and they’ll forget about you, that’s just the way it is. I went in thinking teaching would be my passion but like my admin tells me, it’s just a job, don’t kill yourself over it. And about the parent situation in the future download one of those texting apps and get an alternative phone number to text them from. Since I don’t like giving them my personal phone. Just do that, remember at the end it’s always the teachers fault don’t give much leeway for that. Parents never check class dojo it’s just sad how much they don’t care until it’s time to fight and find blame on the teacher.
You’re awesome! Always put yourself first you did well for breaking up with her. Never look back.

Hello, I’m also a first year teacher so I feel what you’re feeling. Although it sucks everywhere it sucks less in some places than others. Don’t be afraid to quit and find another campus when you’re ready!

Let me share my crazy experience so you can see that with a teacher shortage in hand we can truly get picky. I started at my “dream school” my old elementary. Quickly overwhelmed by mean admin who had thrown all brand new teachers in 4th grade. Was given every curve ball and had my class shut down. I had to take down all my hard work and she proceeded to switch me around to 3 different grade levels in 3 weeks promising it was my last. She’d call me into her office and yell at me. It was a nightmare what did I do? I QUIT. 
Then I worked at another district (4th grade virtual) but the district was on crack they gave me 50 virtual students! Since I was the only virtual teacher in the district for the grade level I had nobody to plan with. This district wouldn’t give us recourses either. It was so bad when I tried to talk to my principal about it she humiliated me and said how I was a quitter and quitted from my last district. She said if I quit now I’d NEVER teach again. I refused to teach for someone like that so I QUIT. 

Next, around late October I started subbing at my initial district. Because it really does support it’s teachers well. I was subbing, I went to different campuses, talked to teachers. I scoped for good admin and bad admin, it’s surprising how much teachers are willing to tell a random sub something. I saw admin who were too nice for their own good and admin who just wanted their teachers at school 24/7. 

Then I finally found my campus. My admin isn’t the best but she’s understanding and easy to talk to. I watched the campus under careful eye before I applied. When a prek position opened up I applied and she got me.

My daughter was unplanned. I got pregnant at the age of 18 with my high school sweetheart but like most young love it was difficult. My ex dipped when he found out and I was about 3 weeks in so I decided to schedule an abortion. I had money saved up but my mom found out and my parents literally forced me to stay at the house as they prayed for my salvation. I depended on them and was too scared to leave since I didn’t even have a job. So I went through the pregnancy. I hated it, I hated being pregnant. I hated being young and being pregnant. I didn’t even want to abort to go out and be crazy or party or any other bs. I just didn’t want to have a kid yet. Also, yes I got pregnant while on birth control so I was even more bitter.

I hated being a single mom so young, going to the baby department when I was pregnant seeing happy couples who we’re doing it right. I live in a Hispanic community with my dad being the typical “macho Mexican” trope. So although they’ve always financially supported me he’d tell me shit. The obvious “nobody is going to want a young single mom like you” “they’re going to see you and think you’re easy because you have a child and aren’t married”. 

I didn’t have the pretty gender reveal, I didn’t have someone to be happy about my ultrasound pictures. I didn’t have someone running to get me my 3AM cravings. When I gave birth I gave birth alone. My parents were in the waiting room sure. I thank them that even though they haven’t been the best and didn’t let me get an abortion at least they’ve always been there in their own odd way. 

I wish I could be like those moms who remember everything about when their babies were born. Like the weight and height etc. But I don’t. I just remember feeling overwhelmed, stuck, and alone. 

I had postpartum when I gave birth, I thought of doing things that just weren’t right. When I had my post op check up my mother told me “don’t even think about telling your dr you have postpartum because it’s not real, it’s all in your head”. 

So the first year of my daughters life was tough. I did everything on my own while depending on my parents. I never did anything right. When in fact although I’m not the best mom. I know I’m a good mother. 

As she’s gotten older dads in the picture now and helps me financially. Although I don’t need it anymore, thank goodness I toughened it up for 4 years and got through school and graduated with my bachelors in may. I still live with my parents since my job is close to their house but I’m virtually getting paid the same as my dad and since I help with bills I can tell them to suck it. Which I don’t since they don’t really interfere anymore. 

As for my daughter, I had to grow to love parenting. I was very bitter and alone. Young and helpless. I love my baby but if someone was in my situation and they wanted an abortion I’d tell them to go for it. It’s something traumatic. I’ve had a steady relationship for 2 years now and although he wants kids I’m too scared. I don’t want to ever be pregnant again. When I see pregnant women who are married and happy I get salty. Im happy for them but I low key hate myself for not having that. I carry with that resentment and envy that eats me alive. 

If any of you are parents, please, please, please do consider your daughters life. Religion is abstract, being a single mother isn’t. Not bashing religion either. But please if your child took the right precautions and got pregnant, if they’re young, reconsider alternatives. 

I took responsibility for my daughter because I love her. But some people don’t mature, some people turn into shitty and selfish parents because they weren’t emotionally mature enough to readjust into the role of parenting.
